Prompt engineering, fine-tuning, inference optimization, computer vision (Bildverarbeitung), chunking and reranking appear only in the responsibilities, so they are not labeled.
The generative AI and LLM mentions collapse into one llms criterion; the Generative AI and LLM aliases both map to llms.
'Orchestrierung mit Docker, Kubernetes' reads as container orchestration. It is covered by containerization (quoted from 'Containerisierung'), not llm-orchestration.
The 'Frameworks wie LangChain, PyTorch und TensorFlow' line names the specific frameworks only. No deep-learning parent is added.
Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD and MLOps also appear in the responsibilities. Their raw_text quotes the requirements-section wording so the determining mention can be identified.
Seniority: 'fundierte Erfahrung' (solid experience) has no years and no stated level. I read it as not equivalent to 'proven experience', so seniority is none; flagged for review.
Degree: 'oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung' widens the field, not the requirement, so degree_or_equivalent is false.
